Third-party files bundled with Nemvo Analytics, so that browsers load nothing
from a CDN or any other site. All are unmodified copies of the published
packages unless noted.

chart/chart.umd.min.js              chart.js 4.5.1               MIT        https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
chart/chartjs-chart-geo.umd.min.js  chartjs-chart-geo 4.3.6      MIT        https://github.com/sgratzl/chartjs-chart-geo
                                    (includes d3-geo, d3-array, d3-color, d3-interpolate, d3-scale-chromatic
                                    and topojson-client, ISC: https://github.com/d3, https://github.com/topojson)
chart/chartjs-chart-matrix.min.js   chartjs-chart-matrix 3.1.0   MIT        https://github.com/kurkle/chartjs-chart-matrix
countries.json                      world-atlas 2.0.2            ISC        https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
                                    Natural Earth 1:50m countries (public domain), simplified with
                                    topojson-simplify (quantile 0.5) and re-quantized to 1e4. Country ids
                                    were changed from ISO numeric to ISO alpha-2 codes; the "land" object
                                    was removed.
cap/                                @cap.js/widget 0.1.58 and @cap.js/wasm 0.0.8 (Apache-2.0),
                                    pako 2.1.0 (MIT, Zlib). See cap/README.txt.

License texts are in the LICENSE-*.txt files next to each component.
